The leader peptide causes attenuation of the mRNA and stabilizes the structure preventing further translation. When erythromycin is present it binds the leader peptide causing a change in conformation allowing for the expression of ErmB.
AAC(6')-Ib10 is an integron-encoded aminoglycoside acetyltransferase in P. aeruginosa.
QacEdelta1 is a resistance gene conferring resistance to antiseptics. It is different from QacE only at the 3'-terminus.
Variant of ErmA (ARO:3000347) found in Streptococcus pyogenes. Confers the MLSb phenotype.

The mphB gene encodes for MPH(2')-II. This enzymes phosphorylates 14-membered and 16-membered macrolides.  It phosphorylates macrolides in GTP- dependent manner at 2'-OH hydroxyl of desosamine sugar of macrolides.
TLA-2 is a beta-lactamase is present on a plasmid isolated from an unidentified bacterial strain from a waste water treatment plant. The enzyme mostly hydrolyzes cephalosporins.
AdeC is the outer membrane factor of the AdeABC multidrug efflux complex. It can be replaced by other outer membrane channels and is not essential for antibiotic resistance.
EreD is an erythromycin esterase protein.

PmrC mediates the modification of Lipid A by the addition of 4-amino-4-deoxy-L-arabinose (L-Ara4N) and phosphoethanolamine resulting in a less negative cell membrane and decreased binding of polymyxin B.
Tet(W) is a ribosomal protection protein. It is associated with both conjugative and non conjugative DNA and has been found strains of Clostridioides difficile.
QepA2 is a plasmid-mediated quinolone resistance pump found in an Escherichia coli isolate from France.

Plasmid or integron-encoded nucleotidylylation of 2-deoxystreptamine aminoglycosides at the hydroxyl group at position 2'' in P. aeruginosa K. pneumoniae Morganella morganii E. coli S. typhimurium C. freundii and A. baumannii.
catB2 is a plasmid-encoded variant of the cat gene found in Escherichia coli Salmonella enteritidis and Pasteurella multocida.
LpsB is involved in lipopolysaccharide synthesis. It confers intrinsic resistance to colistin and other peptide antibiotics.

AmvA has 14 alpha-helical transmembrane segments qualifying it as a member of the DHA2 transporter family of the major facilitator superfamily (MFS). When AmvA was expressed in E. coli  the cells had at least four-fold decreased susceptibility to erythromycin acridine orange acriflavine deoxycholate and methyl viologen. AmvA from the AC0037 strain of A. baumannii was tested.

Plasmid or integron-encoded nucleotidylylation of 2-deoxystreptamine aminoglycosides at the hydroxyl group at position 2'' in P. aeruginosa K. pneumoniae Morganella morganii E. coli S. typhimurium C. freundii and A. baumannii.
VEB-9 is a beta-lactamase. Name originally from the historical Lahey list of beta-lactamases some of which did not include sequence data.
CARB-4 is a beta-lactamase found in Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
CARB-9 is a beta-lactamase found in Vibrio cholerae.
catB8 is a plasmid or integron-encoded variant of the cat gene found in Klebsiella pneumoniae Salmonella typhi and Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
dfrA16 is an integron-encoded dihydrofolate reductase found in Salmonella enterica.
aadA13 is an aminoglycoside nucleotidyltransferase gene encoded by plasmids and integrons in Pseudomonas rettgeri P. aeruginosa Y. enterocolitica and E. coli.
CfxA2 beta-lactamase is a class A beta-lactamase found in Prevotella intermedia.
TEM-1 is a broad-spectrum beta-lactamase found in many Gram-negative bacteria. Confers resistance to penicillins and first generation cephalosphorins.
dfrA15 is an integron-encoded dihydrofolate reductase found in Vibrio cholerae.

APH(3')-Ia is a transposon-encoded aminoglycoside phosphotransferase in E. coli and S. enterica. It is identical at the protein sequence to APH(3')-Ic an aminoglycoside phosphotransferase encoded by plasmids transposons and genomic islands in K. pneumoniae A. baumannii S. marcescens Corynebacterium spp. Photobacterium spp. and Citrobacter spp.
AdeI is the membrane fusion protein of the AdeIJK multidrug efflux complex.
AdeJ is a RND efflux protein that acts as the inner membrane transporter of the AdeIJK efflux complex. It has 57% identity with E. coli AcrB.
ANT(3'')-Ia is an aminoglycoside nucleotidyltransferase gene encoded by plasmids transposons integrons in Enterobacteriaceae A. baumannii P. aeruginosa and Vibrio cholerae.
Multidrug efflux pump in E. coli. This multidrug efflux system was originally identified as the Cmr/CmlA chloramphenicol exporter.
dfrB2 is an integron-encoded dihydrofolate reductase found in an uncultured bacterium from a wastewater treatment plant.
AcrS is a repressor of the AcrAB efflux complex and is associated with the expression of AcrEF. AcrS is believed to regulate a switch between AcrAB and AcrEF efflux.
Tet(36) is a tetracycline resistance gene found in Bacteroides similar to Tet(Q) and binds to the ribosome to confer antibiotic resistance as a ribosomal protection protein.
lnuD is a plasmid-mediated nucleotidyltransferase found in Streptococcus uberis.
AdeK is the outer membrane factor protein in the adeIJK multidrug efflux complex.
aadK is a chromosomal-encoded aminoglycoside nucleotidyltransferase gene in B. subtilis and Bacillus spp. This enzyme confers low-level resistance to streptomycin.
AdeN is a repressor of AdeIJK a RND-type efflux pump in Acinetobacter baumannii. Its inactivation increases expression of AdeJ.

ErmC is a methyltransferase that catalyzes the methylation of A2058 of the 23S ribosomal RNA in two steps. Expression of ErmC is inducible by erythromycin. The leader peptide causes attenuation of the mRNA and stabilizes the structure preventing further translation. When erythromycin is present it binds the leader peptide causing a change in conformation allowing for the expression of ErmC.
The bacA gene product (BacA) recycles undecaprenyl pyrophosphate during cell wall biosynthesis which confers resistance to bacitracin.
TetL is a tetracycline efflux protein found in many species of Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacteria.

The AadT pump is a novel multidrug efflux pump from the proton antiporter 2 (DHA2) family and was discovered in Acinetobacter multidrug resistance plasmids. The presence of AadT decreased bacterial susceptibility to antibiotics (erythromycin and tetracycline) biocides (chlorhexidine) and dyes (ethidium bromide and DAPI) and was able to mediate ethidium transport.

The MdtG protein also named YceE appears to be a member of the major facilitator superfamily of transporters and it has been reported when overexpressed to increase fosfomycin and deoxycholate resistances. mdtG is a member of the marA-soxS-rob regulon.
Tet(M) is a ribosomal protection protein that confers tetracycline resistance. It is found on transposable DNA elements and its horizontal transfer between bacterial species has been documented.
A novel Tn4551 streptomycin-resistance gene that was phenotypically silent in wild-type Bacteroides; expression could be activated by a trans-acting chromosomal mutation.
RATA-2 is a class A RATA-family carbapenemase.
LnuH is a lincosamide nucleotidyltransferase transferase.
RNA-polymerase binding protein which confers resistance to rifampin.

H-NS is a histone-like protein involved in global gene regulation in Gram-negative bacteria. It is a repressor of the membrane fusion protein genes acrE mdtE and emrK as well as nearby genes of many RND-type multidrug exporters.
EreA2 is an integron-encoded erythromycin esterase that hydrolyses the drug's lactone ring. EreA2 is found in Providencia stuartii.
dfrA5 is an integron-encoded dihydrofolate reductase found in Vibrio cholerae.
EreA2 is an integron-encoded erythromycin esterase that hydrolyses the drug's lactone ring. EreA2 is found in Providencia stuartii.
EreB is an erythromycin esterase-like protein that hydrolyses the drug's lactone ring.
A chloramphenicol resistance determinant described in Campylobacter coli.
QnrS1 is a plasmid-mediated quinolone resistance protein found in Shigella flexneri.
A class A beta-lactamase described in Acidaminococcus fermentans. ACI-1 was the first description of a beta-lactamase enzyme in a gram-negative anaerobic cocci. Described by Galan et al 2000.
ANT(6)-Ib is an aminoglycoside nucleotidyltransferase gene encoded by transferable pathogenicity islands in C. fetus subsp. fetus and B. subtilis.
Tet44 is a tetracycline resistance gene found in Campylobacter fetus and binds to the ribosome to confer antibiotic resistance as a ribosomal protection protein.
YajC interacts with the AcrAB-TolC efflux pump in a way that in uncharacterized but is shown to grant increased fitness in the presence of linezolid rifampicin and vancomycin.
aadA17 is an integron-encoded aminoglycoside nucleotidyltransferase gene in Aeromonas media.
cmx is a plasmid or transposon-encoded chloramphenicol exporter that is found in Corynebacterium striatum and Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
mphE is a macrolide phosphotransferase and resistance gene identified on a plasmid pRSB105.

MsrE is an ABC-F subfamily protein expressed to Klebsiella pneumoniae that confers resistance to erythromycin and streptogramin B antibiotics. It is associated with plasmid DNA. It is also 100% identical to ABC-F type ribosomal protection protein Msr(E) which is in multiple species.
QnrVC4 is an integron-mediated quinolone resistance protein found in Aeromonas punctata.
TetA is a tetracycline efflux pump found in many species of Gram-negative bacteria.

APH(6)-Id is an aminoglycoside phosphotransferase encoded by plasmids integrative conjugative elements and chromosomal genomic islands in K. pneumoniae Salmonella spp. E. coli Shigella flexneri Providencia alcalifaciens Pseudomonas spp. V. cholerae Edwardsiella tarda Pasteurella multocida and Aeromonas bestiarum.
APH(3'')-Ib is an aminoglycoside phosphotransferase encoded by plasmids transposons integrative conjugative elements and chromosomes in Enterobacteriaceae and Pseudomonas spp.
CfxA6 beta-lactamase is a class A beta-lactamase found in an uncultured bacterium.
RNA-polymerase binding protein which confers resistance to rifampin.

nimE is a nitroimidazole reductase mainly found in Bacteroides fragilis that is associated with the deactivation of nitroimidazole antibiotics such as metronidazole. Minimum inhibitory concentrations observed in isolates vary greatly depending on species strain and nitroimidazole treatment.
Tet(O) is a ribosomal protection protein. It is associated with conjugative plasmids.
Mrx is part of the macrolide inactivation gene cluster in Aeromonas hydrophila.

The mphA gene encodes for resistance enzyme MPH(2')-I which preferentially inactivate 14-membered macrolides (e.g.erythromycin telithromycin roxithromycin) over 16-membered macrolides (e.g.tylosin spiramycin). It phosphorylates macrolides at 2'-OH hydroxyl of desosamine sugar of macrolides in a GTP-dependent manner.
OmpA is a porin that confers resistance to beta-lactam antibiotics.
dfrA14 is an integron-encoded dihydrofolate reductase found in Escherichia coli.
AAC(3)-IId is a plasmid-encoded aminoglycoside acetyltransferase in E. coli.
APH(4)-Ia is a plasmid-encoded aminoglycoside phosphotransferase in E. coli.
AAC(3)-IV is a plasmid-encoded aminoglycoside acetyltransferase in E. coli C. jejuni and P. stutzeri.
TetD is a tetracycline efflux pump found exclusively in Gram-negative bacteria.
In the presence of antibiotic stress E. coli overexpresses the global activator protein MarA which besides inducing MDR efflux pump AcrAB also down- regulates synthesis of the porin OmpF.
AbeM is an multidrug efflux pump found in Acinetobacter baumannii.
RNA-polymerase binding protein which confers resistance to rifampin.
lnuB is a plasmid-mediated nucleotidyltransferase found in Streptococcus lutetiensis.
TetA(P) is a inner membrane tetracycline efflux protein found on the same operon as the ribosomal protection protein TetB(P). It is found in Clostridium a Gram-positive bacterium.
The first allele of a 16S rRNA methyltransferase gene rmtD2 confers a high resistance to all clinically available aminoglycosides.
Erm42 confers MLSb phenotype in Pasteurella multocida.
OXA-101 is a beta-lactamase. Name originally from the historical Lahey list of beta-lactamases some of which did not include sequence data.
OXA-2 family class D beta-lactamase OXA-1136.
OXA-129 is a beta-lactamase found in Salmonella enterica.
NPS-1 is a plasmid-encoded class D beta-lactamases identified from two Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolates in 1986.

TetB(P) is a tetracycline ribosomal protection protein found on the same operon as tetA(P) a tetracycline efflux protein.

ANT(6)-Ia is an aminoglycoside nucleotidyltransferase gene encoded by plasmids and chromosomes in Staphylococcus epidermidis E. faecium Streptococcus suis S. aureus E. faecalis and Streptococcus mitis.
AdeS is a sensor kinase in the AdeRS regulatory system of AdeABC. It is essential for AdeABC expression.
AdeR is a positive regulator of AdeABC efflux system. AdeR inactivation leads to susceptibility to aminoglycoside antibiotics.
The mphG gene encodes a macrolide 2'-phosphotransferase found in Photobacterium damselae sharing sequence similarity to mphA in E. coli.

KpnE subunit of KpnEF resembles EbrAB from E. coli. Mutation in KpnEF resulted in increased susceptibility to cefepime ceftriaxon colistin erythromycin rifampin tetracycline and streptomycin as well as enhanced sensitivity toward sodium dodecyl sulfate deoxycholate dyes benzalkonium chloride chlorhexidine and triclosan.

Mutation in KpnEF resulted in increased susceptibility to cefepime ceftriaxon colistin erythromycin rifampin tetracycline and streptomycin as well as enhanced sensitivity toward sodium dodecyl sulfate deoxycholate dyes benzalkonium chloride chlorhexidine and triclosan.
Sul3 is a sulfonamide resistant dihydropteroate synthase similar to Sul1 and Sul2. Its resistance gene was found encoded in E. coli plasmid DNA of sulfonamide resistant isolates.

Protein subunit of AcrA-AcrB-TolC multidrug efflux complex. AcrB functions as a herterotrimer which forms the inner membrane component and is primarily responsible for substrate recognition and energy transduction by acting as a drug/proton antiporter.
AcrA is a subunit of the AcrAB-TolC multidrug efflux system found in E. coli.

MCR-5 is a transposon-associated phosphoethanolamine transferase gene identified in Salmonella Paratyphi B dTa+ (d-tartrate fermenting Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Paratyphi B) isolates from food-producing animals. The isolates were collected between 2011 and 2013 and retrieved from the German National Reference Laboratory for Salmonella. MCR-5 confers resistance to collistin through the addition of a phosphoethanolamine group to lipid A causing a reduction in negative charge of the cell membrane. Described by Borowiak et al 2017.
CpxA is a membrane-localized sensor kinase that is activated by envelope stress. It starts a kinase cascade that activates CpxR which promotes efflux complex expression.
